paragraphs.source_en: But this proposal greatly displeased the young lord of the castle, Matsudaira Hirotada. For if it were adopted, Hirotada, who had volunteered to recapture Anshō Castle, would lose face. Hirotada did not wish merely to defend Okazaki passively; he wanted Imagawa support to retake Anshō Castle. Anshō Castle lay close at hand, and whenever Hirotada saw the followers of his great-uncle Matsudaira Nobusada—who had taken advantage of his youth and gone over to Oda—brazenly passing through its gates, he found the sight unbearable.

paragraphs.source_en: Hirotada had always hoped to recapture Anshō Castle with the help of Imagawa Yoshimoto. Caught between the two powers, he could do no more than strive to preserve his own house.
